items.title_orig: Winning Phoebe Bridgers Tickets, Rather Than Buying Them (If You Can't For Any Reason)
items.article_text:
Following the general discourse around ticket prices and concerts in general, I wanted to share a hobby of mine -- winning radio contents to get concert tickets -- in case someone here could win tickets rather than buy them for Phoebe's shows.
 Playing to win radio contests is kind of like playing the lottery, except it doesn't cost money (other than the tax implication at the end of the year) and sometimes you end up with amazing shows. I saw Sarah McLachlan, Kristin Chenoweth, Iron Maiden, Aerosmith, Ghost, Greta Van Fleet, Pearl Jam, Pat Benatar, and even gone to festivals for free by just trying this strategy.
